senses.gloss: m. (preced.) [distributor, cmp. Lat. dispensator,] manager, purser.—Pl. פּוֹרָסֵי.
units: Yoma 9ᵃ מאי פרהדרין פ׳ what does parhedrin mean? Managers (v. פַּרְהֶדְרִין).

<cite ref="Yevamot 45b:9">Yeb. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>מנייה בפ׳ דבבל</he> appointed him one of the collectors of Babylonia; <cite ref="Shabbat 154a:4">Sabb. 154ᵃ</cite> <he>בפוֹרָסַיָּה דבבל</he>; (Rashi <he>בפורסי</he>; Tosaf. <he>אַפּוֹרָסַיָּה</he>, <he>אפורסייה</he> over the collectors of &c.).—[<cite ref="Gittin 28b:10">Gitt. 28ᵇ</cite>, v. next w.]
